cohort: 184 women with acute mastitis and 201 women without mastitis of childbearing age
finding: Protective factors for acute mastitis included regular nipple cleansing, cesarean section, and Balanced Constitution, while risk factors included nipple infection, primiparity, improper diet, emotional stimuli, postpartum colostrum overdue for more than 72 h, breastfeeding more than 7 times each day, late primiparity age, and Qi-Deficiency Constitution.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was a protective factor for acute mastitis.
